$description: The single source of truth for Malachi's interface colors. Authored in OKLCH. Generates assets/src/styles/tokens.css, tui/src/theme/generated.rs, lib/malachi/ui/tokens.ex and docs/design/tokens.snapshot.json. Nothing hand mirrors a palette. See docs/design/operator-interfaces.md section 4.

$meta.profile: DTCG-shaped, privately pinned. The DTCG Design Tokens Format Module is a preview draft that states it must not be implemented, so this file follows its shape for interoperability and pins its own schema for conformance.
gates: Regenerate and fail CI on `git diff --exit-code`.
Fail on any raw color literal in assets/src or tui/src outside generated files: #hex, oklch(, rgb(, hsl(, Color::Rgb, Color::Indexed, named Color::.
Cross language contract test: the web parses tokens.css, Rust deserialises tokens.snapshot.json, both assert field by field in both directions so a missing and an extra token each fail.

Contrast: every declared foreground on background pair in both themes, including muted-foreground on muted and every state on both background and card. Plus a deuteranopia distinguishability check across chart.1 to chart.5.

$platforms.web: CSS custom properties on :root and .dark, exposed through @theme inline.
$platforms.tui: Rust consts. Three tiers per theme: TRUECOLOR, ANSI256, ANSI16. The 256 tier is quantised perceptually at generate time. The 16 tier is hand declared below and is never computed, because a nearest neighbour search collapses state.damaged onto state.fenced.
$platforms.elixir: Module attributes, for any server rendered fallback page.

base.$description: The shadcn semantic set, adopted unchanged. primary is deliberately NOT the brand accent: it is bound to the default button, selected states and badges, and a saturated primary fights the state colors that carry the real meaning.

brand.$description: Amber, carried over from benchmark/dashboard/index.html so the console is continuous with the one page in this project that was designed on purpose. Used for the focused accent and the logo, never for a state.

state.$description: Malachi's own vocabulary. Capped at what the control plane can actually distinguish. A vocabulary larger than the state machine becomes a lie in the docs and in the translation catalog.

active.$description: Taking writes: an active segment, a serving range, an alive node.

sealed.$description: Sealed and settled. Calm, not celebratory.

fenced.$description: Write fenced. Neither healthy nor broken.

damaged.$description: Rot, torn tail, bad CRC, bad magic.

behind.$description: A copy short of the sealed length, or a consumer behind.

ahead.$description: A copy past the sealed length (#175). Rare and serious, and deliberately not red, so it does not read as ordinary damage.

blocked.$description: A range that cannot take writes (#91).

unknown.$description: The control plane cannot currently answer. Not an error.

severity.$description: Signals roll up through these. The health score arithmetic is published: ok counts 1, warning 0.5, error 0, worst child wins at every level.

chart.$description: Time series only. Never reused for a state. Checked for deuteranopia distinguishability by the generator.

$ansi16.$description: Hand declared, never computed. A naive nearest neighbour collapses state.damaged and state.fenced onto the same red, which is exactly the distinction an operator needs at 3 a.m. Values are ANSI SGR color numbers; ratatui's named Color variants are emitted for them.

$terminal.$description: Terminal only concerns. See operator-interfaces.md section 8.4.
$terminal.$backgroundNote: The sentinel `default` emits no color and inherits the terminal's own background, as k9s does. A TUI that paints its own dark background inside a configured light terminal reads as broken and destroys transparency setups. An explicit theme_background override exists for operators who want the painted background.

modifiers.$description: Because a 16 color terminal cannot carry eight distinct states by hue alone, and because meaning is never encoded in color alone (WCAG 1.4.1).

glyphs.$description: Colour depth and glyph richness are two orthogonal degradation axes with separate config keys, as btop separates truecolor from graph_symbol. Nerd Font glyphs are opt in, off by default, and versioned, because codepoints moved between Nerd Fonts v2 and v3 and there is no reliable way to detect glyph coverage.

detection.$description: The terminfo.dev order, applied exactly. COLORTERM is the only positive truecolor signal; TERM=xterm-256color means an indexed palette, not 24 bit.
order: OSC probes, parallel, 100 to 200 ms timeout, degrade on no reply

density.$description: Row heights. WCAG 2.5.8 sets the floor for a pointer target at 24 by 24 CSS pixels, so the compact tier is only permitted on rows that carry no inline target.

default.$description: The default. Matches Carbon's small row.

compact.$description: Only where there are no inline targets.

motion.$description: Nothing above 150 ms, and only on a state the operator caused. Data surfaces do not move by default. prefers-reduced-motion is honored. Explicitly forbidden: full page spinners, number roll ups, slide in on a tail, and shimmer on a refetch.
